subject: SIG Response — development provenance, CI traces, secrets rotation
messages:
From: BlueRock Assessor <assess@bluerocksec.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
Cc: procured@finbank.com
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request — development provenance and CI/CD proofs

Hi Naomi,

Thank you for taking this through so quickly. As part of FinBank's SIG review we need artifacts that demonstrate the following for the code paths that handle customer PII and model inference routing:

- End-to-end code review lineage for the last three releases (author, PR id, reviewer, approval timestamp)
- CI pipeline traces showing successful test runs and signed build artifacts for the same releases
- Secrets management evidence (rotation cadence, access logs for vault ops, ephemeral key usage patterns)
- Change management entries for emergency and scheduled rollouts covering Jan–Feb 2027

Prefer consolidated artifacts (one archive) and a short index file describing mappings to SIG questions. Can you confirm a delivery ETA and whether any items will need redaction?

Thanks,
Oliver Martin
BlueRock Security — Assessment Lead

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: BlueRock Assessor <assess@bluerocksec.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — development provenance and CI/CD proofs

Hi Oliver — thanks for the checklist. We're assembling an evidence bundle and can deliver a primary package plus a supplementary export if needed. Quick notes up front:

- We can provide PR-level lineage tied to commit SHAs and the CI build IDs used to produce released artifacts. Sensitive committer emails will be redacted where requested.
- CI traces: we will export the pipeline run logs and signed artifacts for the three releases (2027-01-11, 2027-01-28, 2027-02-19).
- Secrets: we will provide rotation policy, key rotation timestamps, and anonymized access logs that show vault operations (user ids obfuscated); full HSM audit blobs are controlled and require FinBank NDA escalation — flag if you need them.
- Change management: we'll include the chronological CSV with approvals, rollout windows, and rollback records.

Deliverables planned by EOD Thu 2027-03-04: code_review_lineage_2027-02.pdf, ci_pipeline_traces_202702.tar.gz, secrets_rotation_policy.md, change_management_chronology.csv. We'll also include an index.md that maps files to SIG questions.

If you need anything earlier for scoping, we can send the PR lineage first.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Compliance & Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request — packaging artifacts and redaction notes

Naomi / Marissa — I ran an extraction of the CI runs and signed artifact metadata this morning. A few implementation notes for the bundle:

- The CI export includes pipeline_id, step timestamps, test matrix results, and the signature block for the produced wheel/container image. Logs include test names but do not include full stack traces for proprietary model weights (we've truncated heavy dumps).
- For secrets, the access logs are exported with user ids mapped to short internal aliases (alias_001). Vault operations show rotate/create/read with ISO timestamps. We sanitize any key material, of course — only metadata and operation hashes are exported.
- Change management CSV contains one emergency change (2027-02-08) with rollback noted and the RC approver. We include the postmortem summary as an appendix.

I attached a short manifest (manifest.txt) inside the archive describing redaction rules. Let me know if BlueRock needs HSM audit tokens — that requires a separate request due to vendor controls.

--
Dev Patel
Staff SRE, Redwood Inference

Attachment: manifest.txt (plain text, 3KB)

From: naomi_feldman@redwood.ai
To: BlueRock Assessor <assess@bluerocksec.com>, ACME Audit <sig@acme-audit.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: SIG evidence delivery — FinBank package (index + artifacts)

Hi Oliver / team,

Per our plan, attached is the FinBank SIG evidence bundle. Contents (high level):

1) code_review_lineage_2027-02.pdf — PR-level lineage for the three target releases, reviewer signatures, and links to internal review threads.
2) ci_pipeline_traces_202702.tar.gz — exported pipeline run logs, test matrices, and signed build artifacts.
3) secrets_rotation_policy.md — policy document with rotation cadence, service account rules, and a sanitized access log excerpt.
4) change_management_chronology.csv — chronological change entries with approvers and rollback notes.
5) index.md — maps SIG questions to files/sections and notes where redaction was applied.

A couple of clarifications:
- We redacted personal emails in reviewer metadata; contactable aliases are preserved so you can trace approvals without exposing PII.
- HSM-level audit artifacts are available but require an additional vendor consent step per our contract. If FinBank wants those, please confirm and we'll initiate the request (DOCUSIGN-req-9981).

Links to the package are on the shared drive (see related links in metadata). If you want an alternate format (CSV instead of PDF for the lineage), we can provide that within 24 hours.

Thanks — looping in Jonas for any technical follow-ups and Marissa for contractual notes.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Director, Compliance & Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: code_review_lineage_2027-02.pdf (PDF, 420KB); ci_pipeline_traces_202702.tar.gz (tar.gz, 12.4MB); secrets_rotation_policy.md (markdown, 6KB); change_management_chronology.csv (CSV, 22KB); index.md (markdown, 4KB)
